title: HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT RFC 9220 Foundation Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9220 HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT foundation.
scope: This verification covers SETTINGS_ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL value 0x08 and default zero, round-trip settings parse/write behavior, duplicate setting rejection, RFC 8441-style Extended CONNECT pseudo-header validation, unsupported-protocol 501 response creation, optional problem-details payload creation, orderly closure-to-FIN mapping, and reset exception-to-H3_REQUEST_CANCELLED mapping.
preconditions: The RFC 9220 specification exists as canonical JSON at `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-RFC9220.json`.
The RFC 9220 foundation remains in `Incursa.Quic.Http3` rather than in the core QUIC transport runtime.
expected_result: The focused HTTP/3 tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9220 artifacts, generated triage reflects the trace-owned RFC 9220 foundation, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The RFC 9220 HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT foundation is trace-owned and verified. Full WebSocket tunnel forwarding, WebSocket frame handling, HTTP Datagram, CONNECT-UDP, CONNECT-IP, and MASQUE support remain future work.
